line_1: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High
line_2: shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

line_1: I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress:
line_2: my God; in him will I trust.

line_1: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler,
He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust:
line_2: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

line_1: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night;
line_2: nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

line_1: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness;
line_2: nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

line_1: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand;
line_2: but it shall not come nigh thee.

line_1: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold
line_2: and see the reward of the wicked.

line_1: Because thou hast made the LORD, which is my refuge,
line_2: even the most High, thy habitation;

line_1: There shall no evil befall thee,
line_2: neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

line_1: For he shall give his angels charge over thee,
line_2: to keep thee in all thy ways.

line_1: They shall bear thee up in their hands,
line_2: lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

line_1: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder:
line_2: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

line_1: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him:
line_2: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.

line_1: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble;
line_2: I will deliver him, and honour him.
